select '1' as code,'1' as name,1 as usd_amt_sq , 1 as usd_amt from dual where 1>2
union all select T.code,gb.gb_name as name,usd_amt_sq, usd_amt from ( select mx.gbcode as code, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mdt_ckmx mx where mx.tsswjg_dm like #{cxtjDTO.swjgDm}||'%' and ((ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12)) or (ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd}))

group by mx.gbcode )T LEFT JOIN tl_admin.dm_gbcode gb on gb.gb_code=T.code
union all select T.code,gb.gb_name as name,usd_amt_sq, usd_amt from ( select mx.gbcode as code, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_wzf_ckmx mx where mx.tsswjg_dm like #{cxtjDTO.swjgDm}||'%' and ((ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12)) or (ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd}))

and mx.djxh = (select djxh_js from tl_tssh.glxt_bb_shxt_djxx dj where dj.qyhgdm = #{cxtjDTO.qyhgdm} and rownum = 1)

insert into tl_admin.tjbb_dt_d01007(swjgdm,bblc, sjhy_dm,usd_amt_sq,ts_amt_sq,usd_amt,ts_amt,qyhs, usd_amt_tb,ts_amt_tb,hymc,hydm,paramhash) select #{swjgdm}, to_char(row_number() over (order by a.sjhy_dm),'000') bblc, a.*,b.hymc,b.hy_dm,'TEMP-'||#{pramHash} from (select t.sjhy_dm,sum(usd_amt_sq),sum(ts_amt_sq),sum(usd_amt),sum(ts_amt),sum(qyhs), decode(sum(usd_amt_sq),0,0,ROUND((sum(usd_amt)-sum(usd_amt_sq))/sum(usd_amt_sq),4)), decode(sum(ts_amt_sq),0,0,ROUND((sum(ts_amt)-sum(ts_amt_sq))/sum(ts_amt_sq),4)) from tjbb_dt_d01007 t where t.paramhash='TEMP-'||#{pramHash} group by sjhy_dm) a inner join dm_hy_js b on (a.sjhy_dm=b.hy_dm and b.mlbz='Y')

select '01' as bblc, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mdtse else 0 end) as ts_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mdtse else 0 end) as ts_amt from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mdt_ckmx mx where tsswjg_dm like #{cxtjDTO.swjgDm}||'%'
union all
select '02' as bblc, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mdtse else 0 end)*100 as ts_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mdtse else 0 end)*100 as ts_amt from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mdt_ckmx mx where tsswjg_dm like #{cxtjDTO.swjgDm}||'%'
select '01' as bblc, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.tse else 0 end) as ts_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.tse else 0 end) as ts_amt from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mts_ckmx mx where tsswjg_dm like #{cxtjDTO.swjgDm}||'%'
union all
select '02' as bblc, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjStart},-12) and add_months(#{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd},-12) then mx.tse else 0 end)*100 as ts_amt_sq, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.mylaj else 0 end) as usd_amt, sum(case when ckrq_1 between #{cxtjDTO.cksjStart} and #{cxtjDTO.cksjEnd} then mx.tse else 0 end)*100 as ts_amt from tl_tssh.ckts_sb_mts_ckmx mx where tsswjg_dm like #{cxtjDTO.swjgDm}||'%'
)

insert into tl_admin.tjbb_dt_d01002(swjgdm,bblc,paramhash,je,je_sq,tb)
select #{swjgdm},'03', #{pramHash}, decode(#{MDTSE},0,0,ROUND(#{MDSE}*100/#{MDTSE},2)) as je, decode(#{MDTSE_SQ},0,0,ROUND(#{MDSE_SQ}*100/#{MDTSE_SQ},2)) as je_sq, decode( decode(#{MDTSE_SQ},0,0,ROUND(#{MDSE_SQ}*100/#{MDTSE_SQ},2)),0,0, round(decode(#{MDTSE},0,0,ROUND(#{MDSE}*100/#{MDTSE},2))/decode(#{MDTSE_SQ},0,0,ROUND(#{MDSE_SQ}*100/#{MDTSE_SQ},2))-1,4) ) from dual
mapper.select: select distinct(swjgdm) as swjgdm from tl_admin.tjbb_dt_e01001 t

select swcode,sum(tse_fh) as tse_fh,sum(tse_hz) as tse_hz, sum(tse_sp) as tse_sp,sum(tse_kp) as tse_kp from ( select tsswjg_dm_1 as swcode, case when RN=1 then tse_fh else 0 end as tse_fh, case when RN=1 then tse_hz else 0 end as tse_hz, tse_sp,tse_kp from ( select a.tsswjg_dm_1,a.fszzstse + a.fsxfstse as tse_fh, case when a.ywhzwcbz='Y' then a.fszzstse + a.fsxfstse else 0 end as tse_hz, b.sehzzzstse + b.sehzxfstse as tse_sp, case when b.scsssrthsbz='Y' then b.sehzzzstse + b.sehzxfstse else 0 end as tse_kp, row_number() over(partition by a.ywhzbuuid order by b.xh_4) as RN from hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywhzb a left join hx_ckts.ckts_ty_sehzb b on a.ywhzbuuid=b.ywhzbuuid where a.tsswjg_dm_1 like #{swjgdm}||'%' and a.ywhzsj between #{rqq} and #{rqz} ) pt ) ps group by swcode
select tsswjg_dm_1 as swcode, sum(a.fszzstse - a.fsxfstse) as tse_whz from hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywhzb a where a.tsswjg_dm_1 like #{swjgdm}||'%' and nvl(a.ywhzwcbz,'N')='N' group by tsswjg_dm_1

select swcode, sum(tse_hz - tse_sp) as tse_wsp, sum(tse_sp - tse_kp) as tse_wkp from ( select tsswjg_dm_1 as swcode, case when RN=1 then tse_hz else 0 end as tse_hz, tse_sp,tse_kp from ( select a.tsswjg_dm_1, a.fszzstse + a.fsxfstse as tse_hz, b.sehzzzstse + b.sehzxfstse as tse_sp, case when b.scsssrthsbz='Y' or b.zzssssrthsbh is not null or b.xfssssrthsbh is not null then b.sehzzzstse + b.sehzxfstse else 0 end as tse_kp, row_number() over(partition by a.ywhzbuuid order by b.xh_4) as RN from hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywhzb a left join hx_ckts.ckts_ty_sehzb b on a.ywhzbuuid=b.ywhzbuuid where a.tsswjg_dm_1 like #{swjgdm}||'%' and a.ywhzwcbz='Y' ) pt ) ps group by swcode
